verses.en: How beautiful are thy feet with shoes, O prince’s daughter! the joints of thy thighs are like jewels, the work of the hands of a cunning workman.
verses.pt: Ele: Como são belos os teus pés nas sandálias, ó filha de príncipe! Os contornos de tuas coxas são como joias, como obra das mãos de um artesão.
verses.en_web: How beautiful are your feet in sandals, prince’s daughter! Your rounded thighs are like jewels, the work of the hands of a skillful workman.
verses.en_bbe: How beautiful are your feet in their shoes, O king's daughter! The curves of your legs are like jewels, the work of the hands of a good workman:

verses.en: Thy navel is like a round goblet, which wanteth not liquor: thy belly is like an heap of wheat set about with lilies.
verses.pt: Teu umbigo é como uma taça redonda, que não falta bebida; teu abdome é como um amontoado de trigo, rodeado de lírios.
verses.en_web: Your body is like a round goblet, no mixed wine is wanting. Your waist is like a heap of wheat, set about with lilies.
verses.en_bbe: Your stomach is a store of grain with lilies round it, and in the middle a round cup full of wine.

verses.en: Thy two breasts are like two young roes that are twins.
verses.pt: Teus dois seios são como dois filhos gêmeos da corça.
verses.en_web: Your two breasts are like two fawns, that are twins of a roe.
verses.en_bbe: Your two breasts are like two young roes of the same birth.

verses.en: Thy neck is as a tower of ivory; thine eyes like the fishpools in Heshbon, by the gate of Bath-rabbim: thy nose is as the tower of Lebanon which looketh toward Damascus.
verses.pt: Teu pescoço é como uma torre de marfim; teus olhos são como os tanques de peixes de Hesbom, junto à porta de Bate-Rabim. Teu nariz é como a torre do Líbano, que está de frente a Damasco.
verses.en_web: Your neck is like an ivory tower. Your eyes are like the pools in Heshbon by the gate of Bathrabbim. Your nose is like the tower of Lebanon which looks toward Damascus.
verses.en_bbe: Your neck is as a tower of ivory; your eyes like the waters in Heshbon, by the doorway of Bath-rabbim; your nose is as the tower on Lebanon looking over Damascus:

verses.en: Thine head upon thee is like Carmel, and the hair of thine head like purple; the king is held in the galleries.
verses.pt: Tua cabeça sobre ti, como o monte Carmelo, e o trançado dos cabelos cabeça como púrpura; o rei está como que atado em tuas tranças.
verses.en_web: Your head on you is like Carmel. The hair of your head like purple. The king is held captive in its tresses.
verses.en_bbe: Your head is like Carmel, and the hair of your head is like purple, in whose net the king is prisoner.

verses.en: How fair and how pleasant art thou, O love, for delights!
verses.pt: Como tu és bela! Como tu és agradável, ó amor em delícias!
verses.en_web: How beautiful and how pleasant you are, love, for delights!
verses.en_bbe: How beautiful and how sweet you are, O love, for delight.

verses.en: This thy stature is like to a palm tree, and thy breasts to clusters of grapes.
verses.pt: Esta tua estatura é semelhante à palmeira, e teus seios são como cachos de uvas.
verses.en_web: This, your stature, is like a palm tree, your breasts like its fruit.
verses.en_bbe: You are tall like a palm-tree, and your breasts are like the fruit of the vine.

verses.en: I said, I will go up to the palm tree, I will take hold of the boughs thereof: now also thy breasts shall be as clusters of the vine, and the smell of thy nose like apples;
verses.pt: Eu disse: Subirei à palmeira, pegarei dos seus ramos; e então teus seios serão como os cachos da videira, e a fragrância de teu nariz como o das maçãs.
verses.en_web: I said, “I will climb up into the palm tree. I will take hold of its fruit.” Let your breasts be like clusters of the vine, the smell of your breath like apples,
verses.en_bbe: I said, Let me go up the palm-tree, and let me take its branches in my hands: your breasts will be as the fruit of the vine, and the smell of your breath like apples;

verses.en: And the roof of thy mouth like the best wine for my beloved, that goeth down sweetly, causing the lips of those that are asleep to speak.
verses.pt: E tua boca seja como o bom vinho; Ela: Vinho que se entra a meu amado suavemente, e faz falarem os lábios dos que dormem.
verses.en_web: Your mouth like the best wine, that goes down smoothly for my beloved, gliding through the lips of those who are asleep.
verses.en_bbe: And the roof of your mouth like good wine flowing down smoothly for my loved one, moving gently over my lips and my teeth.

verses.en: I am my beloved’s, and his desire is toward me.
verses.pt: Eu sou do meu amado, e ele me deseja.
verses.en_web: I am my beloved’s. His desire is toward me.
verses.en_bbe: I am for my loved one, and his desire is for me.

verses.en: Come, my beloved, let us go forth into the field; let us lodge in the villages.
verses.pt: Vem, amado meu! Saiamos ao campo, passemos as noites nas aldeias.
verses.en_web: Come, my beloved, let us go out into the field. Let us lodge in the villages.
verses.en_bbe: Come, my loved one, let us go out into the field; let us take rest among the cypress-trees.

verses.en: Let us get up early to the vineyards; let us see if the vine flourish, whether the tender grape appear, and the pomegranates bud forth: there will I give thee my loves.
verses.pt: Saiamos de madrugada até às vinhas, vejamos se as videiras florescem, se suas flores estão se abrindo, se as romãzeiras já estão brotando; ali te darei os meus amores.
verses.en_web: Let’s go early up to the vineyards. Let’s see whether the vine has budded, its blossom is open, and the pomegranates are in flower. There I will give you my love.
verses.en_bbe: Let us go out early to the vine-gardens; let us see if the vine is in bud, if it has put out its young fruit, and the pomegranate is in flower. There I will give you my love.

verses.en: The mandrakes give a smell, and at our gates are all manner of pleasant fruits, new and old, which I have laid up for thee, O my beloved.
verses.pt: As mandrágoras espalham seu perfume, e junto a nossas portas há todo tipo de excelentes frutos, novos e velhos; eu os guardei para ti, meu amado.
verses.en_web: The mandrakes produce fragrance. At our doors are all kinds of precious fruits, new and old, which I have stored up for you, my beloved.
verses.en_bbe: The mandrakes give out a sweet smell, and at our doors are all sorts of good fruits, new and old, which I have kept for my loved one.
